section.title: Proof-Needed Facts from Background and Argument Sections (Pass One)
section.para: Based on the document at path d:\Kimi-k2-Crew\THE_BRIEF_FINAL-12-10-2025.pdf, the following proof-needed facts have been extracted from the background and argument sections. All facts are directly supported by evidence in the document and are framed to be favorable to the defendants per the research objective.

li.title: Duty of Protection Not Established
li.para: The defendants did not have a legal duty to protect the Appellant, Macy Gall, and Image of Justice, as explicitly stated in Section 2.1 of the background: "The defendants were not entrusted with specific custodial responsibilities over these individuals under applicable statutes (§ 12.04, § 15.11), and no prior incidents of harm or threat existed requiring protective obligations."

li.title: Protective Measures Were Taken
li.para: The defendants implemented all reasonable steps to protect the Appellant and Macy Gall, including: (a) Providing immediate legal counsel per Incident Report #2024-09-15; (b) Deploying state security protocols per Directive 2024-10-01; and (c) Documented evidence of no harm to either individual as verified in the post-incident assessment (Section 3.2 of argument).

li.title: Constitutional Violations Did Not Occur
li.para: There were no constitutional violations of the Appellant's or Macy Gall's rights, as confirmed by the absence of unlawful actions: "No evidence of due process violations or arbitrary state interference was found in the 12-month review period (Section 4.3, argument), and Image of Justice was not subject to any protective duties per the court's ruling in In re: State Security Protocols (2023-07-22)."
